main_flow_steps: click verification link to activate account

inputs.constraints: at least 8 characters, not in the 100 most commonly used passwords

expected_outcomes: account created with read-only access
email verification link sent
account activated after verification
account suspended after 7 days if not verified

business_rules.source_text: Password must be at least 8 characters
reject the 100 most commonly used passwords
Email must be verified via a confirmation link before the account is fully activated
unverified accounts can still log in but are limited to read-only access for 7 days
after which they're automatically suspended

acceptance_criteria: new user can sign up with email and password
email verification link is sent after sign up
account is activated after email verification
unverified account has read-only access for 7 days
unverified account is suspended after 7 days
passwords less than 8 characters are rejected
commonly used passwords are rejected

main_flow_steps: user initiates upgrade to Pro plan
system prorates charge for remaining days
expected_outcomes: user gains access to advanced features
charge is prorated based on days remaining in billing cycle

business_rules.description: prorate charge based on days remaining in billing cycle when upgrading mid-billing-cycle
business_rules.source_text: Upgrading mid-billing-cycle should prorate the charge based on days remaining in the current cycle

business_rules.description: downgrade from Pro to Free takes effect at end of current billing period
business_rules.source_text: Downgrading from Pro to Free should NOT be immediate — it should take effect at the end of the current billing period

business_rules.description: block downgrade from Team to Pro if team has more members than Pro allows
business_rules.source_text: If a Team-plan user downgrades to Pro and currently has more team members than Pro allows, the downgrade should be blocked until they remove members

acceptance_criteria: user can access advanced features after upgrading to Pro
charge is prorated correctly when upgrading mid-billing-cycle
downgrade from Pro to Free takes effect at end of billing period
downgrade from Team to Pro is blocked if team has too many members

expected_outcomes: Tasks and projects are created
Upgrade prompt is shown when project cap is exceeded
429 error with retry-after header is returned when rate limit is exceeded

business_rules.source_text: The Free tier is capped at 3 active projects
50 tasks per project
API requests are rate-limited to 60 requests/minute for Free tier
600/minute for Pro/Team

acceptance_criteria: User can create tasks and projects
User is prompted to upgrade when creating a project beyond the cap
User receives a 429 error with retry-after header when exceeding the rate limit

inputs.constraints: must be one of Admin, Editor, Viewer

expected_outcomes: Teammates are assigned roles

business_rules.description: A user holds exactly one role per team
business_rules.source_text: A user holds exactly one role per team

business_rules.description: Only the account owner can transfer ownership to another Admin
business_rules.source_text: Only the account owner can transfer ownership to another Admin

preconditions: user has not previously used a Pro trial with the same account
main_flow_steps: user has access to full Pro features during the trial
if payment method is added, account remains Pro after trial
if no payment method is added, account downgrades to Free on day 14
expected_outcomes: user has full Pro features during the 14-day trial
account downgrades to Free on day 14 if no payment method is added
first charge occurs on day 15 if payment method is added during the trial

business_rules.source_text: Trial eligibility is one-time per account

business_rules.description: no immediate charge on adding payment method
business_rules.source_text: the first charge should not occur until day 15, not immediately on adding the card

business_rules.description: automatic downgrade to Free on day 14 without payment method
business_rules.source_text: the account should automatically downgrade to Free rather than continuing Pro access unpaid

acceptance_criteria: user has full Pro features during the 14-day trial
account downgrades to Free on day 14 if no payment method is added
first charge occurs on day 15 if payment method is added during the trial
user cannot start a second Pro trial with the same account
ambiguities: detection method for previous trial eligibility (email match only, or also payment fingerprint) isn't finalized

expected_outcomes: data is exported in machine-readable format
account is deleted after 24-hour grace period
deletion is cancelled if requested within 24-hour grace period

business_rules.description: team-plan export scope for non-owner members
business_rules.source_text: a team-plan export triggered by a non-owner member should only include that member's own tasks
24-hour grace period during which the user can cancel it

acceptance_criteria: user can export all projects and tasks in machine-readable format
team-plan export by non-owner member only includes their own tasks
account deletion is cancelled if requested within 24-hour grace period
account is permanently deleted after 24-hour grace period

main_flow_steps: User selects notification types to opt out of

inputs.constraints: Defaults to 9am local time if set, otherwise UTC

expected_outcomes: Notification preferences are updated
Digest emails are sent at the selected time
Changes take effect for the next scheduled notification

business_rules.source_text: security-related notifications (password changes, new device login) cannot be disabled

business_rules.description: Digest email send time is based on user's timezone
business_rules.source_text: Digest emails are sent at a time based on the user's timezone, defaulting to 9am local time

business_rules.description: Changes do not affect already queued notifications
business_rules.source_text: Changing notification preferences should take effect for the next scheduled notification, not retroactively affect ones already queued

acceptance_criteria: User can opt out of individual notification types
Security-related notifications are always sent
Digest emails are sent at the correct time based on user's timezone
Changes to notification preferences take effect for the next scheduled notification
